name: 60115 · Dekalb, IL
findings: ZIP 60115 (Dekalb) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60115 (Dekalb) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60115 (Dekalb) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
